name: Canny
summary: Customer feedback and feature request tracking.

flows.title: Create a post
steps: Click the pencil icon at the top of the page. Only Canny admins can create posts here.

flows.title: Create a board
steps: Open the Boards tab in the Canny settings.
Click the Create board button at the top and follow the prompts. A board title can be up to 40 characters.

flows.title: Change a post's status
steps: Go to the post in the admin view, in the Feedback tab.
Select a status from the dropdown in the right-hand panel of the post. A comment, with an image, can be added as part of the update.
